paper_title: Frequency Ratio Measurements with 18-digit Accuracy Using a Network of Optical Clocks
notes: This is a metrology paper reporting optical clock frequency ratios (Al+/Yb, Al+/Sr, Yb/Sr) with 18-digit accuracy. It only mentions tests of fundamental physics and dark matter searches as a future/potential application, but does NOT present any actual exclusion limit or constraint on any coupling (no alpha-variation bound, no scalar-photon coupling limit, no coupling-vs-mass data). Therefore no extractable limit exists despite the ScalarPhoton pre-analysis hint.
